idea-plugin.name: Converter Studio
idea-plugin.description:
Convert files from the Project view or an editor tab: images, video, audio, documents, slides, spreadsheets, data and subtitles. Conversions run on your computer first.

Right-click one or more files, choose Convert with Converter Studio…, pick a format, and the result is saved next to the original. A taken name becomes photo (2).jpg; nothing is overwritten. Progress shows in the status bar with Cancel, and a notification offers Open and Show in folder.

Where each conversion runs

  • On this computer (the default): with the plugin's own code (JSON to CSV and back, JSON or CSV to YAML, SRT and VTT subtitles, PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF and TIFF images) and with programs already installed: FFmpeg (video and audio), LibreOffice (Office files to and from PDF), Pandoc (Markdown, HTML, DOCX, EPUB), ImageMagick (WebP, AVIF, HEIC, ICO), Ghostscript (smaller PDFs) and Tesseract (text recognition). The dialog names the program that will do each conversion. The file does not leave your computer.
  • Converter Studio app (optional, off by default): hands the files to Converter Studio for desktop, which also converts on your computer. The app opens with the files and the format chosen; you press Convert there.
  • Cloud (uses credits) (only when you choose it): uploads the file to converter.studio over HTTPS, for conversions your computer cannot do, such as RAW photos, e-books and fonts. It needs a free account and an API key; most image and document conversions cost 1 credit (pricing).

A local conversion that fails never moves to the cloud by itself: the notification offers Try in the cloud (uses credits).

Privacy

No telemetry. Local conversions stay on your computer. A cloud conversion sends the file, and your API key, only to the API address in the settings; the upload is deleted after the conversion and the result after 6 hours. The key is kept in the IDE's password safe, never in settings files. Privacy policy.

Settings: Settings | Tools | Converter Studio. Source code and issues: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: first release. Convert files on this computer (built-in code, FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Pandoc, ImageMagick, Ghostscript, Tesseract), hand them to the Converter Studio desktop app, or convert them in the cloud with an API key.
